description.p: VexPortal is a graphical front end for the vexos-nix justfile. It rebuilds the system, switches roles and GPU variants, toggles optional features, manages server service modules, and moves between NixOS generations — showing only the operations that apply to the role this machine is actually built as.
Privileged work runs through a small system daemon guarded by polkit, so the application itself never runs as root and every operation is recorded in the journal.
